title: The route is a rule
subtitle: Eight rules, applied in order, first match wins. You can read them, and you can disagree with one.
by: startups.engineer, 20 October 2026, a first strip for Dinis to review
rule: The route titles on the graph and the Finder's because line are finder.json's strings word for word (from_finder); the rest is the storyboard's words.
